prompt: Build a Move module for a tagged item collection on Sui. Items should have a name and a list of string tags. Include functions to create items, add tags, remove a tag by index, count tags, and check if a tag exists. Include unit tests.

Write a Move module for a configuration registry on Sui where each config entry has a required key (String), a required value (u64), and an optional description (Option<String>). Include functions to set config (with or without description), read the value, check if a description exists, and extract the description. Include tests.
